start.title: Fils de la Terre
start.text:
Tu es Caïn, premier-né d'Adam.
Ton frère Abel marche à tes côtés à l'aube.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Genesis 4:1-2 — Cain and Abel were the first two brothers, sons of Adam and Eve.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Compare yourself to him in silence
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] A quiet bitterness takes root.
[TODO:fr] He calls your name. You do not turn.

fields.title: Le Laboureur
fields.text:
La terre résiste à ta houe.
Sueurs. Pierres. Les longues heures de travail.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Genesis 4:2 — Cain worked the soil while Abel kept flocks.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Curse the ground as you dig
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Each strike grows angrier than the last.

abel_pasture.title: Le Troupeau de Ton Frère
abel_pasture.text:
Abel se repose parmi ses brebis, content.
Un agneau nouveau-né dort sur sa poitrine.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Be glad for his gentle work
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Warmth rises where envy could have grown.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Resent that his work seems easy
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Genesis 4:5 — Cain grew envious and downcast when God favored Abel.
[TODO:fr] Your words stay quiet, but they sting your own soul.

offerings.title: Devant l'Autel
offerings.text:
Il est temps d'apporter une offrande au Seigneur.
Que donneras-tu ?

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] You choose the finest grain. Your heart is open.
[TODO:fr] Genesis 4:3 — Cain brought some of the fruits of the soil, not his very best.
[TODO:fr] Empty hands. A harder, prouder heart.

accepted.title: La Faveur du Seigneur
accepted.text:
Le Seigneur reçoit l'agneau d'Abel avec joie.
Ton offrande — Il ne la regarde pas.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] You ask why. The answer is already in you.
[TODO:fr] Genesis 4:5 — Cain became very angry when his offering was not accepted.
[TODO:fr] Your fist rises. The sky does not answer.

anger.title: Pourquoi Es-Tu En Colère ?
anger.text:
Ton visage s'assombrit. Tes mains tremblent.
Le Seigneur demande : « Pourquoi es-tu en colère ? »

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Lay your anger down before Him
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] The fire begins to cool. Honesty opens a path.
[TODO:fr] Genesis 4:5-6 — Cain turned his face away and refused to answer God.

warning.title: Le Péché Guette à la Porte
warning.text:
« Le péché guette à ta porte.
Son désir est pour toi — mais tu dois le maîtriser. »

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] You exhale. You will choose differently.
[TODO:fr] Genesis 4:7 — Cain did not master the sin crouching at his door.
[TODO:fr] The warning fades. The hatred remains.

invitation.title: Viens Avec Moi aux Champs
invitation.text:
Abel marche vers toi, confiant.
Son visage est ouvert. Le tien ne l'est pas.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Tell him the truth of your heart
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Words are hard. But honesty is mercy.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Lure him alone into the field
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Genesis 4:8 — Cain lured Abel out into the field.

field.title: Dans le Champ
field.text:
Le champ est vide. Personne ne verra.
La colère monte. Une pierre est dans ta main.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] It falls heavy at your feet. You breathe again.
[TODO:fr] Genesis 4:8 — Cain rose up against Abel his brother and killed him.
[TODO:fr] Your hand obeys the rage. The field receives him.

confrontation.title: « Où est ton frère ? »
confrontation.text:
La voix du Seigneur te trouve.
« Où est ton frère Abel ? »

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Confess what your hands have done
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] The truth crushes you. And begins to free you.
[TODO:fr] Genesis 4:9 — Cain replied, 'Am I my brother's keeper?'

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Stay silent and hide your eyes
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] His blood cries out from the ground.

wanderer.title: À l'Est d'Éden, Marqué
wanderer.text:
Le Seigneur place une marque pour te protéger.
Tu dois errer loin de chez toi.
